The supplied page defines the general full/observed-data record and response-kernel MCAR/MAR/MNAR taxonomy. The assigned page uses the one-outcome, fully observed-X specialization and does not add a causal or likelihood claim.

The actual supplier defines the pattern-indexed observed record and explicitly says missing full-data values are not replaced by zero. The algorithm encodes an observed outcome slot with a zero placeholder only when R=0 and states that R distinguishes this placeholder from an observed zero; the full-data value remains missing.

The actual supplier supplies the full/observed-data interpretation of R. The theorem states the assigned plan's explicit one-outcome MAR premise R independent of Y given sigma(X), then separately proves the population identity; it does not infer finite-sample stability from the supplier.
